answer: Each epoch opens with a public beacon seed, and every identity must compute a sequential delay proof from it: 45 minutes of single-core work that cannot be split, shortcut, or precomputed, yet verifies in milliseconds. Proofs must land in a 60-minute window, so a farm chasing 10,000 identities needs 10,000 cores at once, about $1,000 of rented compute each epoch, while an honest agent pays nothing beyond its own laptop. It is a mesa with one trail up, a spiral staircase walked step by step, like a juniper adding one ring a year: no one can stand on ten thousand stairs at once.
